testDefinitions.notes: Dilute 0.250 g to 100.0 mL with ethanol (96 per cent). Measure absorbance from 260 nm to 400 nm; plot curve; draw baseline tangent AB; maximum C at 315 +/- 3 nm; drop perpendicular from C to AB at D; value = absorbance C - D (limit 0.20 to 0.96). Geometric baseline subtraction is performed graphically; analyst enters the final calculated C - D value per CATALOG.md rule 6 (BP Appendix II B). Sources: Lemon Oil__1-1_STM Lemon Oil.txt:29, 33.
Determine on 5 mL sample with a calibrated refractometer (limit 1.473 to 1.476). (BP Appendix V E). Source: Lemon Oil__1-1_STM Lemon Oil.txt:30.
Pycnometer method: (Wt3 - Wt1) / (Wt2 - Wt1) (limit 0.850 to 0.858). Analyst enters calculated relative density value. (BP Appendix V G). Source: Lemon Oil__1-1_STM Lemon Oil.txt:32.

testDefinitions.displayName: Fatty oils and resinified essential oils (Lemon Oil)
testDefinitions.notes: Allow 1 drop of the essential oil to fall onto filter paper; the drop evaporates completely within 24 h without leaving any translucent or greasy spot. (BP Appendix X M). Source: Lemon Oil__1-1_STM Lemon Oil.txt:34.

Dried beaker weighed (Wt1); 20 mL sample introduced and weighed (Wt2); heated on water bath for 4 h; cooled; beaker with residue weighed (Wt3). Residue (%) = (Wt3 - Wt1) / (Wt2 - Wt1) x 100 (limit 1.8% to 3.6%). (BP Appendix X M). Source: Lemon Oil__1-1_STM Lemon Oil.txt:35.

testDefinitions.displayName: Identification of Croscarmellose Sodium (adsorption of methylene blue)
testDefinitions.notes: Mix 1 g sample with 100 mL of 4 ppm (1 in 250,000) methylene blue solution, stir, and allow to settle. The sample absorbs methylene blue and settles as a blue, fibrous mass (BP 2024 / USP 2024). Source: Croscarmellose Sodium__STM Croscarmellose Sodium.txt:32.

Disperse 10.00 g in 800.0 mL water (W1), stir 1 min every 10 min for first 30 min, stand 1 h, decant 200.0 mL, filter, collect 150.0 mL filtrate into tared 250 mL beaker (W2), evaporate to dryness, dry residue at 100-105 °C for 4 h, weigh (W3). Formula: ((W3 - W2) x 100 x 100) / (W1 x (100 - LOD)). Calculation includes aliquot ratio and LOD correction which the gravimetric workflow cannot compute; analyst enters final percentage value per CATALOG.md rule 6 (BP 2024 Monograph / USP 2024). Source: Croscarmellose Sodium__STM Croscarmellose Sodium.txt:34.

1.000 g in 300 mL 100 g/L NaCl + 25.0 mL 0.1 M NaOH, stand 5 min, add 0.25 mL m-cresol purple, add ~15 mL 0.1 M HCl, then 1 mL portions of 0.1 M HCl to yellow. Titrate with 0.1 M NaOH to violet. Milliequivalents M of base; acid substitution A = 1150*M/(7102 - 412*M - 80*C); sodium substitution S = (162 + 58*A)*C/(7102 - 80*C), where C is sulfated ash %; degree of substitution = A + S (limit 0.60 to 0.85 on dried basis). Calculation involves multi-stage back-titration and multi-variable equation; analyst enters final degree of substitution value per CATALOG.md rule 6 (BP 2024 Monograph / USP 2024). Source: Croscarmellose Sodium__STM Croscarmellose Sodium.txt:37.

Dilute 1 mL solution S to 100 mL with water. To 5 mL add 0.15 mL freshly prepared copper sulfate solution and 2 mL dilute NaOH (solution is blue and clear and remains so after boiling). To hot solution add 4 mL dilute HCl, boil 1 min, then add 4 mL dilute NaOH: an orange precipitate is formed immediately (BP 2024 Monograph). Source: Sucrose__Sucrose -SM.txt:30.

TLC on silica gel plate. Test solution: 10 mg in water/methanol (2:3 V/V) to 20 mL. Reference (a): 10 mg sucrose CRS in same solvent. Reference (b): 10 mg each of fructose, glucose, lactose monohydrate, sucrose. Mobile phase: cold saturated boric acid, 60% V/V glacial acetic acid, anhydrous ethanol, acetone, ethyl acetate (10:15:20:60:60 V/V). Spray thymol in sulfuric acid/ethanol (96%), heat at 130 °C for 10 min. Principal spot in test chromatogram is similar in position, colour and size to that of reference (a) (BP Appendix III A). Source: Sucrose__Sucrose -SM.txt:30.

To 5 mL solution S add 5 mL water, 1.0 mL 1 M NaOH, and 1.0 mL of 1 g/L methylene blue. Mix, place in water bath for exactly 2 min; examine immediately: the blue colour does not disappear completely (ignore blue colour at air/solution interface) (BP 2024 Monograph). Source: Sucrose__Sucrose -SM.txt:34.

50.0 g in 50.0 mL water, filtered (0.45 µm), degassed. Absorbance measured at 420 nm in >= 4 cm cell (10 cm preferred). Calculation from absorbance A, path length b, and concentration c from refractive index Table 0204.-1. Calculation formula incomplete in STM text; Measurement test, analyst enters the final calculated color value (max 45) per CATALOG.md rule 6 (BP Appendix II B, V E). Source: Sucrose__Sucrose -SM.txt:35.

Enzymatic photometric limit test: 4.0 g in 10.0 mL; reference contains 0.5 mL 80 ppm SO2 standard (10 ppm limit). Measured at ~340 nm against water blank. Absorbance difference of test solution must not be greater than half that of reference solution. Qualitative limit test per README.md (analyst records Complies / Does not comply; limit NMT 10 ppm SO2). (BP 2024 Monograph). Source: Sucrose__Sucrose -SM.txt:36.
